text: ROUND 4: production fix COMMITTED on heft worktree branch **fix-dio-unicast-dis-0l4q** (commit e2adf9f3cf, on top of origin/main 343064d752): unicast DIS now elicits the canonical jittered multicast DIO (same trickle path as multicast DIS) instead of send_dio(source) unicast. Suite state after the production change: still 6 failures — EXPECTED: tests assert the old immediate unicast-DIO timing (tests.rs:1099 leaf.receive(1,1) after root DisReceived). REMAINING WORK to land: (1) update the DIS->DIO tests to drive the deterministic jitter (multicast_dis_jitter helper) or poll receive across the trickle window — assertion strength unchanged (leaf must still observe DioReceived consistent); (2) diagnose the DAO-flavored failures separately (dao_radio_failure_retains_exact_finalized_bytes, leaf_send_allocates_each_update, three_rpl_stacks, relay_forwards_original_source, rpl_dispatch_rejects) — DAOs are inherently unicast so the multicast-DIO rule must not apply; suspect the DAO admission path (DaoOriginNotAdmitted / dao_admissions evidence from 6008e4eed8) — instrument DioProcessOutcome-analogous reject reasons on the DAO path if needed; (3) then full suite green => land the branch via normal janitor/CI flow. Worktree ~/wt-0l4q on heft holds the branch + warm target + oscore-fork link.
